title: Harness Lab
blurb: Curated tips and methods that make this Field Brief / EM fleet stronger — Grok bots, Mac CLIs, vault, routines, and launch standards. Keep only what we can apply; not generic AI news.

entries.title: Vault one-way mirror + _inbox/ write-back lane
entries.why: For box↔Mac Obsidian vault staging: one writer as source of truth; rsync one-way to the consumer (exclude .obsidian/ .trash/ .git/); agent writes only into _inbox/ excluded from --delete. Stops silent plugin data.json ping-pong. Fleet vault = notes vault, not HashiCorp.

entries.title: flock + deterministic --session-id against overlapping scheduled -p
entries.why: Scheduled Mac CLI jobs can overlap when a slow run outlives the next tick. Wrap claude -p in flock -n (skip if held) and give each logical job a stable --session-id UUID so retries stay addressable. Distinct from launchd wake/drop-while-running KEEPs — this locks the process itself.

entries.title: Persist Codex thread_id for exact exec resume (safer than --last)
entries.why: When several Codex EM/review tasks share a machine, resume --last can grab the wrong session. Tee --json events, extract thread_id, resume that id. Safer identity handle for parallel Astra/Codex work than cwd-scoped --last.

entries.title: codex exec resume — use -c sandbox_mode=… (not -s)
entries.why: Open issue: codex exec resume rejects -s/--sandbox. A resume without -c sandbox_mode can write a file that the original exec -s read-only blocked. Pass -c sandbox_mode="read-only" (or workspace-write) on every resume. Corrects the 2026-09-30 tip that assumed --sandbox re-passes. Mac codex 0.156.1 resume --help lists -c only.

entries.title: --max-budget-usd hard cap on every scheduled claude -p
entries.why: Print-mode hard ceiling on API spend for one -p run — stops overrun even when turn count is low but tokens are high. Pair with --max-turns and logging total_cost_usd from JSON. Usable on Mac Claude 2.1.221 today (local --help lists the flag).

entries.title: launchd StandardOutPath + zsh -lc PATH for Mac CLI jobs
entries.why: Common LaunchAgent mistakes: omit StandardOutPath/StandardErrorPath (silent /dev/null failures) and forget /bin/zsh -lc so nvm/fnm/~/.local/bin Claude/Codex miss launchd's minimal PATH. For fleet Mac CLI LaunchAgents: always log stdout/stderr, wrap ProgramArguments in zsh -lc, keep RunAtLoad false while iterating, test with launchctl kickstart -k. Distinct from sleep-coalesce and drop-while-running KEEPs.

entries.title: codex exec resume --last — re-pass sandbox on continue
entries.why: Official CLI reference: codex exec resume continues a non-interactive task (--last = cwd most recent; --all searches any dir). Global flags including --sandbox apply on resume — re-state workspace-write (or read-only) rather than assuming the original policy sticks. Useful for Astra EM follow-ups after interrupt; complements existing --json/--output-last-message and workspace-write KEEPs.

entries.title: Log total_cost_usd from every scheduled claude -p
entries.why: Headless docs: --output-format json includes total_cost_usd (+ per-model breakdown) so scripts track spend without the usage dashboard; DEV measured ~150k-token cold -p when -p loads hooks/MCP/CLAUDE.md without --bare. Fleet routines should parse cost into run notes (keep PROXY vs live quota labels separate). Pair with existing --bare KEEP.

entries.title: --permission-mode dontAsk for unattended -p (usable on 2.1.221)
entries.why: Headless docs: dontAsk denies every call that would otherwise prompt (locked-down CI) while still allowing reads/read-only commands and explicit --allowedTools / permissions.allow. Available on Mac Claude 2.1.221 today — do not wait for --permission-prompts none (≥2.1.259, still backlog). Pair with --bare on scheduled EM/collect kicks.

entries.title: amux capture-pane — detect Claude exit to shell (not just log age)
entries.why: Screen-scrape tmux capture-pane for Claude TUI alive (❯ U+276F) vs bare $/% shell after context exhaustion; require a ~10 min last-seen-alive window so fresh/intentional shells are not restarted; 90s restart cooldown; opt-in per session. Extends grok-tmux-watchdog (log-age + Enter only) with TUI-vs-shell discrimination — dry-run first; leave auto-restart OFF on any session that posts or pays.

entries.title: launchd calendar — drop-while-running, silent bad keys, runs-counter health
entries.why: Measured beyond sleep/power-off: calendar firings during an in-flight job are dropped (no queue); unrecognized keys (WeekDay/Second) are silently discarded so weekly→daily; launchctl print has no next-fire-date — the miss signal is runs vs expected slots. Keep LaunchAgent bodies shorter than the interval, lint Weekday spelling, and pair runs with box mac-missed-runs.jsonl as the dead-man's switch.

entries.title: Codex unattended — workspace-write sandbox; network off unless configured
entries.why: Official defaults: workspace-write keeps command network off; enable only via sandbox_workspace_write.network_access (+ optional network_proxy allowlists). Prefer codex exec --sandbox workspace-write (or read-only + never in CI) over --yolo / dangerously-bypass for Astra seats. Complements the existing --json + --output-last-message proof tip with a hard sandbox contract.

entries.title: Claude JSONL mtime + process table — hang vs crash vs clean exit
entries.why: No stock Claude heartbeat: ~/.claude/projects JSONL mtime is the activity signal, but long tools/compact/Retry-After look stale. Pair with process table (stale+alive=hang; stale+gone+orphaned tool_use=crash). Stop hook alone cannot see crashes. Use a longer transcript threshold (30–45m) beside our 540s log watchdog; keep the observer read-only and snapshot TodoWrite via PostToolUse when we add recovery.

entries.title: claude --bare for scripted -p — skip host hooks/MCP/CLAUDE.md
entries.why: Headless docs: --bare skips auto-discovery of hooks, plugins, MCP, auto memory, and CLAUDE.md so CI/scripts get the same result on every machine. Without it, -p loads project .mcp.json and ~/.claude hooks with no trust dialog. Fleet unattended EM/collect kicks should default to --bare plus explicit --allowedTools/--settings. Confirmed on Mac Claude 2.1.221.

entries.title: claude-code-api-watchdog — Continue on transient API errors; leave usage limits alone
entries.why: Outer-loop for unattended Claude-in-tmux: two-poll debounce on stuck API Error/529/transient 429, exponential Continue backoff (2s→120s, 10-attempt cap), escalate then stop; leaves real usage-limit / resets-at alone; auto-restart OFF by default. Extends grok-tmux-watchdog (log-age + Enter) with transient-vs-limit discrimination — dry-run first; --no-restart on any session that posts or pays.

entries.title: Agent reliability — retry/cost/timeout budgets; plan ≠ permission; run records
entries.why: Production checklist for CoS/EM: every run needs retry budget + cost ceiling + wall-clock timeout (escalate, don't degrade quietly); policy enforcement outside the reasoning loop; idempotent writes; structured run records for replay. Rollout ladder read-only → propose → reversible write → broad write matches Three-Run Proof + Tongli human gates. Next step: put budget fields on EM/routine notes.

entries.title: launchd StartCalendarInterval — wake catch-up, but power-off still skips
entries.why: Apple: a launchd job scheduled with StartCalendarInterval runs when the Mac wakes if it slept through the slot (missed slots coalesce into one run), but is skipped if the Mac was off; cron and other launchd jobs simply skip. Mac-side routines should be StartCalendarInterval agents that are idempotent per date, with the box-side missed-runs ledger as the net for power-off/offline days (the 2026-09-25 gap). In playbook (2026-09-28 sync).

entries.title: codex exec — --json + --output-last-message proof, exec resume --last, login status probe
entries.why: Codex CLI reference: pair --json with --output-last-message for unattended runs (event stream + final-summary file), continue with codex exec resume --last (cwd-scoped; --all across dirs) instead of relaunching, and codex login status exits 0 when credentials are present. Gives Astra seats a file proof artifact for vault notes, a watchdog resume path, and an exit-code auth probe for the usage dashboard. In playbook (2026-09-28 sync).

entries.title: claude -p drops quiet subagents at 10 min; SIGTERM leaves the turn unfinished
entries.why: Claude Code headless docs: -p waits for background subagents but drops partial results after 10 minutes of idle waiting (CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS), and SIGTERM exits 143 with no result for the in-progress turn while SIGINT ends it cleanly. grok-tmux-watchdog flags stale at 540s, just under that ceiling — treat the 540–600s window explicitly and send SIGINT before any relaunch/resume. In playbook (2026-09-28 sync).

entries.title: workmux resurrect — crash-recovery resume for agent worktrees
entries.why: Restores tmux/worktree agent sessions after crash from persisted state with agent-specific resume args (Codex resume, etc.). Candidate pattern for Mac CLI relaunch-vs-resume before grok-tmux-run; dry-run first. Lab backlog/smoke — do not replace fleet watchdog. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: Usage honesty — session /status ≠ plan /usage ≠ API spend
entries.why: Codex subagents add model/tool cost beyond a single seat; CLI surfaces differ: session context (/status), plan quota (/usage), and Platform API org spend are not the same meter. For Tongli usage dashboard: keep PROXY labels when estimating routine fires; prefer live CLI quota bars when a seat exposes them; never invent dollar costs. Correct-step KEEP after Muse false-friend Vault noise. In playbook (2026-09-28 sync).

entries.title: Three-Run Proof — Observe → Correct → Release before Lab automation
entries.why: OpenAI harness engineering treats agent work as incomplete until checkable proof (review loops, live artifacts). For Harness Lab: require three independent scout seats (Observe bugs surfaced, Correct fixes pipeline, Release clean E2E) and live Pages verify before enabling daily collect/curate routines. Lab process KEEP; In playbook (2026-09-28 sync).

entries.title: session-bandit — redacted Markdown handoff from local transcripts
entries.why: Indexes Claude Code / Codex local JSONL offline (no API) and export-md writes a redacted, provenance-linked Markdown artifact plus redaction report. Candidate machine-checkable half for box↔Mac EM continuation and vault handoff notes; inspect before filing; backlog/smoke. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: pi-tmux-agents — awaiting_review parent gate before accept
entries.why: Settled child enters awaiting_review; parent must inspect result/workspace then accept|revise|take_over|dismiss|escalate (human only on escalate). Portable CoS pattern for Mac CLI tmux subagents and complements evidence≠instruction. Lab card/backlog — no fleet replace of grok-tmux-watchdog. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: orch — full harness panes on tmux with heartbeats
entries.why: Spawns independent Claude/Codex/Pi/Gemini harnesses in tmux panes (full seats, not shared-turn subagents) with heartbeats and addressable prompts. Closest public substrate idea for future grok-tmux-run lanes; Lab backlog only — do not install as fleet replace. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: hat-tmux workbench — status-line watchdog + single quota writer
entries.why: Public workbench turns tmux status-line redraw into a launchd tracker-server watchdog (≤30s self-heal) and enforces a single writer for the quota cache so handoff state and limit resets stay truthful. Pattern idea for Mac CoS/EM panes before grok-tmux-run; backlog/smoke only. appliedToPlaybook false.

entries.title: Harness sensors — LLM-optimized feedback before human review
entries.why: Martin Fowler: outer harness raises first-pass correctness and adds sensors whose signals are optimized for LLM self-correction before human eyes. Maps to CoS evidence≠instruction, usage miss-watch, and Three-Run Proof as a named sensor on Lab automation. Process KEEP; appliedToPlaybook false until harness playbook page exists.

entries.title: Claude gateway — BASE_URL alone under-counts usage
entries.why: Claude Code docs: setting only ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL still uses the saved claude.ai subscription credential, so a usage proxy can silently under-count. Honest fleet metering needs a gateway credential (gateway /login or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN for a self-hosted gateway) when routing through a proxy. Lab KEEP for usage-dashboard honesty; no secrets published. appliedToPlaybook false.
